fullPassage: Researchers recently found that goldenrods that live in peaceful areas without much threat from predators will issue chemical alarm calls that are incredibly specific — comprehensible only to their close kin — on the rare occasion they are attacked. But goldenrods in more hostile territory signal to their neighbors using chemical phrases easily understood by all the goldenrod in the area, not just their biological kin. Instead of using coded whisper networks, these goldenrod broadcast the threat over loudspeaker, so to speak. It is the first time research has confirmed that these chemical communications are beneficial not only to the plant receiving them but also to the sender. When times are truly tough, you do not want to be left standing in a field alone. There will be no one to mate with, no one to help bring in pollinators.

questions.passage: Researchers recently found that goldenrods that live in peaceful areas without much threat from predators will issue chemical alarm calls that are incredibly specific — comprehensible only to their close kin — on the rare occasion they are attacked. But goldenrods in more hostile territory signal to their neighbors using chemical phrases easily understood by all the goldenrod in the area, not just their biological kin. Instead of using coded whisper networks, these goldenrod broadcast the threat over loudspeaker, so to speak. It is the first time research has confirmed that these chemical communications are beneficial not only to the plant receiving them but also to the sender. When times are truly tough, you do not want to be left standing in a field alone. There will be no one to mate with, no one to help bring in pollinators.
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심 발견: 적대적 환경의 goldenrod는 모든 이웃이 알아듣도록 위험을 '널리 알린다'
det.analysis:
✅ ① When Danger Strikes, Goldenrods Shout to All Their Neighbors(위험이 닥치면 goldenrod는 모든 이웃에게 외친다): 적대 지역의 '널리 방송하는' 신호와 상호 이익이라는 글의 새로운 발견을 포괄 ←정답

❌ ② A Secret Language Shared Only Among Close Relatives(혈족만의 비밀 언어): 평화 지역 일부만 설명, 글의 강조점(모두에게 방송)과 반대

❌ ③ Why Hungry Predators Keep Away From Goldenrod Fields(포식자가 goldenrod 밭을 피하는 이유): 포식자가 피한다는 내용 없음

❌ ④ The Hidden Price of Living in a Peaceful Field(평화로운 들판의 숨은 대가): 평화 지역의 '대가'를 다루지 않음
det.tip: broadcast ... to all neighbors(모두에게 알림) → 모든 이웃에게 외친다

det.korean: receive → receiving: 앞의 명사 the plant를 수식하는 현재분사(능동). the plant receiving them = 그것을 받는 식물

det.tip: 명사 + 현재분사(능동 수식) → the plant receiving them
